chronology.finding: The fixed first prospective recipe completed 72 principal fits and 12 resource replicas on six new development cohorts, but failed its frozen predictive gates; no product promotion or general superiority.
Raw and bounded training-rank channels did not meet the joint quality and inference-cost criteria.
The fixed low-cost conditioning recipe passed cost checks but not the required proper-loss benefit.
196 gradient calls and no neural fit: the fixed-reference variance premise failed. This was not a test of every dynamic cache.
The four-latent attention prototype passed mechanical checks but failed the CPU screen before predictive fits.
5,012 gradient observations across 36 states showed relative variance 0.343, 1.005, 1.468 and 1.000 in four regimes. These are gradient-variance results, not accuracy gains.
Scalar cache reliability and an independent event-row embedding alternative failed their respective screens. A lost timing payload was excluded rather than reconstructed.
The fixed NCDA recipe failed the cost qualification; no predictive fit was admitted.
The fixed initialization recipe was rejected after 69 completed neural fits; protected selection was not opened to rescue it.
148 full-training gradient calls, no fits or updates: the single-probe premise failed; predictive quality was not measured.
The numerical representation passed functional checks but failed the cost gate before predictive fits.
The initial competitive panel did not satisfy admission; the proposed 27 fits were not started.

24 principal fits, three fresh replicas and 600 paired inference windows established a canonical 32-member neural comparator on three development studies. Selection/preprocessing differences prevented attributing the gap to architecture alone.
The fixed panel was not admitted. Absence of fits did not falsify an optimizer or architecture.

No new Efficient or Flagship recipe passed all gates. The best paired median primary-metric improvement was 1.67%, below 2%; 144 derived policies were correlated evaluations, not independent experiments.

Overfitting, a local benefit from more training, and a benefit from aggregating ensemble members were observed. No checked projection-rank collapse was found. Rare-category pooling lost identity, with predictive consequences unresolved.
A three-fold neural teacher-to-student recipe was technically plausible only as a reduced pilot. The full 72-fit plan exceeded the 27-fit budget; teachers were not treated as free.
Admission defects and an unfavorable local signal prevented promotion. This does not falsify neural distillation in general.
The fixed eight-component CRPS regression recipe failed; component count and weights were not tuned after the result.
Fixed-checkpoint analysis distinguished mean bias and other possible limits without proving a universal representation or optimization cause.
Pooling collisions alone did not establish predictive harm. Recurrence, support and a valid predictive contract were required.
Only one eligible family was available; the independent panel was insufficient.
Fourteen fits, including two qualification fits, showed heterogeneous unit/context effects; no general architectural causal conclusion followed.
Training composition and source availability limited admission. Group identifiers were required when the statistical contract required them, not automatically for every task.
The fixed 27-fit screen failed its noise and positive-control gates despite a local real-data noise effect.
A controlled synthetic noise effect passed local criteria in 21 fits. This was not independent evidence of a general real-data gain; the regularization follow-up was not admitted.
The fixed 27-fit pilot did not pass the two-real-family gate. The earlier synthetic effect remained valid in its original scope.
The fixed 27-fit pilot did not confirm uniform fragility and did not justify a selector.
The fixed 24-fit width-preservation recipe produced no robust material predictive benefit; incomplete CPU controls were retained as limitations.
Training-only fixed-model decomposition found no single dominant cause and admitted no architecture. Product stabilization remained a separate track.
Recovered baselines and scientific state; no predictive fits in this recovery cycle.
Twenty-four neural fits rejected the fixed ordinal-head and Quasi-Poisson recipes. Both remain closed.
Eighteen neural fits and two convex controls gave an overall -0.14% result and failed the rotation control; no convincing speed or memory gain.
Fixed-weight backward controls demonstrated Adam coordinate sensitivity. This was not evidence of a predictive improvement.

chronology.family: row-shared second moment and nullable path
chronology.finding: The shared-row second-moment strategy was rejected. Nullable-path local timings were preliminary and required joint qualification.
The original nullable recipe showed local gains but failed because of regressions and unstable measurements. Its verdict was not rewritten.

chronology.family: selective nullable path and complex guard
chronology.finding: Correctness evidence was favorable in scope, but cost qualification was incomplete; no integration.
Object-path A/A failed. A conservative Yogi-like filter failed a strong-rare-signal control; this did not falsify Yogi in general.
The 27-fit recipe did not beat the frozen predictive controls. SMT interference remained a hypothesis, not an established cause of timing noise.
Unreliable timing comparisons were suspended. Saved models and analytic controls tested semantic-loss premises without new fits.
Functional feasibility did not establish predictive admission or a generalization benefit.
The semantic recipe failed CPU qualification. Six baseline diagnostic fits did not justify promotion.
Existing trajectories motivated checkpoint-selection questions, without establishing an improved learning algorithm.
The selector premise failed before implementation or new fits.
The fixed bound-based screen failed; thresholds were not changed to recover it.
Reconciled evidence and qualified a restricted development panel without new learner fits.
The development factorial was completed; independent binary confirmation and general promotion remained unavailable.
A restricted three-task development study supplied diagnostic evidence, not a promoted general recipe.
Validator and diagnostic controls passed in scope; a fresh independent binary source was not qualified.
Source qualification stopped and confidence failures were identified; no new predictive fit was admitted.

Stable-kernel checks on 100 extreme cases found no demonstrated numerical bug. Casting saturated probabilities to float64 cannot recover lost precision; NLL and clipped log loss have different semantics.

Extreme standardized values came from genuine out-of-support observations and sparse-feature imputation/variance effects. The stem and unnormalized residual propagated scale; float64 checks did not show a substantial numerical error.
The transform passed numerical checks in its qualified domain; cost was acceptable only in the Flagship screen. Invertibility did not prove preservation of useful rare signals or predictive benefit.
Training-observed-value scaling passed functional checks but A/A prevented cost qualification. Separate baseline/source diagnostics were not candidate efficacy evidence.
Fixed-model causal diagnostics did not justify promotion or independent predictive claims.
The integrated runner was not yet qualified; a real predictive trial was not admitted.
Runner qualification remained incomplete. Data-integrity findings were retained without predictive promotion.
The integrated runner was qualified in its checked scope; no broad generalization benefit was established.
Local training-budget and frontend diagnoses did not establish that more epochs generally improve prediction.
Temporal signal was observed, without robust superiority of the proposed representation.
A local order signal did not qualify general complementarity between RMS and lag information.
Local cost checks were qualified, but independent validation of generalization remained blocked.
The fixed independent criteria rejected general transfer of the RMS-plus-lag recipe; it was not promoted.
A no-fit probability-quality and causal audit prioritized qualification of a competitive benchmark.
The software stage passed. Of 27 proposed trials, 21 were attempted: 20 passed, one stopped at its technical budget and six were cancelled. This was not an architectural verdict.
Restricted competitive and resource evidence was collected. Different checkpoint metrics and budgets prevented direct causal attribution of the architecture gap.
All 34 baseline epochs were reconstructed: patience caused stopping and logged LR followed the scheduler. Ranking exceeded prevalence despite all-majority decisions at threshold 0.5.
Constant learning rate versus cosine had a positive result on two simulated development families under fixed capacity/work. This was not real-data confirmation.
The independent real-data panel was not yet admissible; the original recipe and reservations were preserved.
Historical overlap, provenance and predictive-contract checks limited new-source admission.
Feature availability, rights and statistical-unit evidence still prevented admission; screening was not predictive evidence.
The fixed C38 recipe was actually tested on two qualified real families. Uniform benefit was not confirmed: one family had a local 7.74% benefit. There was no default promotion.
Twelve retained trajectories and 360 epochs supported train/eval/dropout decomposition. No new fits were run and the proposed follow-up was stopped.
Conflicting labels for identical permitted features imposed 69 unavoidable training errors in one deterministic contract. This was not a Bayes-error estimate or proof of an architectural limit.
Residual/local information diagnostics did not establish a sufficiently distinct new loss or admit new fits.
Ranking, threshold decisions and calibration were separated. No new threshold was selected on protected confirmation and no fit was promoted.
Technical equivalence checks supported private buffer/view changes; numerical equivalence alone did not qualify overall speed or RSS.

Across the C47/C48 technical suite, 114 cases and nine fits supported equivalence. Only 2 of 64 timing A/A blocks were valid; IPC/acknowledgement failures and clock disagreement invalidated certification.

A 72-73% parameter reduction did not preserve predictive quality across development families. Twenty-seven model/artifact sets were lost through worker-temporary storage. Their absence is recorded; they were not recreated or replaced with invented artifacts.
Checksums, manifests, durable readback and interruption/resume were qualified for the tested CPU epoch-boundary path. This does not certify power-loss, GPU or arbitrary mid-batch recovery.
The new private architecture failed predictive criteria. Fewer parameters were not accepted as a substitute for accuracy.
One local positive result did not generalize or pass the other control. Adaptive steps for non-interpolating objectives remained a separate question, not an admitted improvement.
The constructor avoided 823 imports while preserving tested updates. Cold-start observations were exploratory; compiler and GPU paths were not fully qualified.
126 cases and 3,072 updates supported exactness in scope. First optimizer-state export imported the deferred stack; constructor savings were not a complete-fit speedup.

Cold/no-state-export fits may benefit, but checkpoints can pay the deferred cost. Cache/layout alternatives lacked general benefit. One warm CPU profile assigned 80.22% to forward/loss/backward; it was not a universal profile or certified acceleration.

24 software API fits, 48 initial/refit phases, 120 epochs and 48 fresh persistence loads supported tested equivalence. No independent predictive improvement, general timing gain or process-RSS reduction was certified.

evidence_dimensions.generalization: Requires qualified independent units, roles and dataset families; local development benefits are insufficient.
evidence_dimensions.equivalence: Checked weights, outputs, updates, RNG and persistence within explicitly tested scopes.
evidence_dimensions.timing: Separate import, initialization, full fit/checkpoint and inference. Invalid environmental or A/A gates prevent certification.
evidence_dimensions.memory: Separate tensor/live storage, traced temporary allocations, process peak RSS and VRAM. Parameter count is not RAM.
evidence_dimensions.correctness: Numerical or mathematical correctness does not establish calibration, robustness or predictive benefit.

research_principles: Evidence before complexity; negative results remain knowledge.
Separate stable software from exploratory mechanisms.
Replicate with frozen protocols, paired controls and inclusive compute.
Keep reserved evaluation separate and closed during development.
Make workload-specific claims; no universal superiority claim.

research_phases.motivation: Explore cheap changes before larger campaigns.
research_phases.approach: Routing, interactions, schedules, transforms and adapters; six Micro-Lab batches.
research_phases.evaluation: Small real and synthetic diagnostics; 54 distinct Micro-Lab IDs and 648 recorded scientific fits, with baseline reuse.
research_phases.result: Local signals, reversals, cost failures and inconclusive screens motivated stronger controls.

research_phases.motivation: Establish binary baselines and test optimization, activation and calibration.
research_phases.approach: Paired baseline, GELU, batch/exposure and checkpoint/calibration tests.
research_phases.evaluation: Initially 13 binary datasets with fixed paired seeds; narrower trajectory tests for calibration.
research_phases.result: GELU and update frequency showed local gains; no general calibration improvement.
research_phases.decision: Advance selected hypotheses only to stronger comparisons.

research_phases.motivation: Confirm activation changes beyond short screens.
research_phases.approach: Component tests, broader real panels and fresh confirmation.
research_phases.evaluation: Up to 22 eligible real datasets; H6C reused H6 results and is not an independent replication.
research_phases.result: Earlier GELU gains were not sufficient for a general default; the fresh confirmation also lacked complete original integrity bindings.
research_phases.decision: Keep the SiLU default; preserve the historical positive signal and integrity limitation.

research_phases.motivation: Reduce sensitivity to stopping, splits and trajectories.
research_phases.approach: Patience, crossed seed-role diagnostics and checkpoint averaging.
research_phases.evaluation: Paired real binary panels with separate diagnostic and confirmation roles.
research_phases.result: Patience did not establish general stability. Averaging improved mean AUC but failed variance and concentration gates.
research_phases.decision: No general stability or averaging mechanism promoted.

research_phases.motivation: Test feature-token representations and their explanation.
research_phases.approach: Uniform attention followed by offline causal review.
research_phases.evaluation: Eight datasets with paired seeds for attention; no new fits in the follow-up.
research_phases.result: A positive average hid a worst-case failure; the proposed hybrid explanation was unsupported.
research_phases.decision: No representation replacement; hybrid architecture was not built.

research_phases.motivation: Find a practical multitask backbone improvement.
research_phases.approach: Input gating, preprocessing selection, stagewise learning and stronger compute controls.
research_phases.evaluation: Staged tests culminating in a 39-dataset development panel.
research_phases.result: Input gating remained historically positive and unpromoted. Stagewise gains failed the stronger compute comparison; longer training showed regression-specific gains.
research_phases.decision: No new stable default; retain scoped positive signals.

research_phases.motivation: Search for specialist or adaptive headroom.
research_phases.approach: Seventeen bounded forms, MIMO failure analysis and policy-oracle analysis.
research_phases.evaluation: Small staged panels plus offline analysis of fixed policies.
research_phases.result: MIMO had concentrated gains and severe failures; no safe universal cue or sufficient quality-first policy headroom emerged.
research_phases.decision: No specialist routing or learned meta-policy.

research_phases.approach: Probabilistic circuits, prior-fitted prototypes, relaxed logic and deep equilibrium models.
research_phases.evaluation: Staged small real/synthetic tests with fresh confirmation for the DEQ hint.
research_phases.result: Invalid circuit attempts were separated from corrected weak results; the DEQ hint did not confirm.
research_phases.decision: No radical-family signal in the exact tested forms.

research_phases.motivation: Use tree knowledge or training methods to improve the backbone.
research_phases.approach: Out-of-fold distillation, structural transfer and training-only methods.
research_phases.evaluation: Teacher-inclusive cost controls, prospective graph controls and fresh regression confirmation.
research_phases.result: No broad practical survivor; an early structural hint did not pass its controls.

research_phases.motivation: Test task-specific models, amortization and uncertainty.
research_phases.approach: Eight task-specific forms, a shared synthetic-prior pilot and a last-layer Gaussian approximation.
research_phases.evaluation: Staged task panels, synthetic acceptance gates and ten regression datasets with three seeds.
research_phases.result: No task-specific survivor; synthetic gates stopped amortization before real data; uncertainty breadth and coverage were insufficient.
research_phases.decision: No new backbone, pretrained predictor or interval feature.

research_phases.motivation: Decompose failures and assess complementary models.
research_phases.approach: Retrospective diagnostics, neural/tree blending and official external neural recipes.
research_phases.evaluation: 23 diagnostic cohorts, an 18-dataset blend panel and staged external comparisons.
research_phases.result: Multiple partial failure mechanisms; blend cost/robustness failed; external results were mixed with incomplete matched coverage.
research_phases.decision: No single explanation, hybrid promotion or automatic external adoption.

research_phases.approach: Mechanical gate, repair, then controlled scientific comparison.
research_phases.evaluation: Synthetic mechanics followed by 15 observational datasets and two seeds.
research_phases.result: Repair passed mechanics; the scientific comparison failed quality and robustness.

research_phases.motivation: Identify and validate a justified next mechanism.
research_phases.approach: Prior-art/control review, variable-projection mechanics and candidate red-teaming.
research_phases.evaluation: Algebraic fixtures and analysis; no scientific variable-projection fits.
research_phases.result: Numerical acceptance failed; no subsequent candidate met admission requirements.
research_phases.decision: Quality unevaluated for variable projection; no next mechanism.

research_phases.motivation: Consolidate knowledge and seek new reopening evidence.
research_phases.approach: Source-bound history review and literature audit.
research_phases.evaluation: Existing records and reviewed papers; no new scientific fits.
research_phases.decision: Research remains frozen; historical roadmap proposals are superseded.

research_phases.motivation: Check failure hypotheses on newly catalogued development data.
research_phases.approach: Grouped duplicate-feature splits, fixed neural/tree recipes and perturbation controls.
research_phases.evaluation: 27 UCI datasets, nine per task, three seeds; 306 fits with no failed, censored or retried fits.
research_phases.result: Ten material neural losses and several counterexamples; causal hypotheses remained partial.
research_phases.decision: No research reopening; freshness is relative to the audited catalog.

research_phases.approach: Identity, alias, seed, overlap and failure-panel infrastructure.
research_phases.evaluation: 117 scoped identities and 80 campaign records; prospective failure panels were not executed.
research_phases.result: Useful navigation and heuristic checks; incomplete first-use and reservation evidence remain.
research_phases.decision: Infrastructure readiness is not research admission.

research_phases.motivation: Decide whether evidence justifies another research phase.
research_phases.approach: Zero-fit candidate review and inexpensive arithmetic checks.
research_phases.evaluation: No estimator fits, scientific solvers, dataset loading or new seed campaign.
research_phases.result: No candidate met the combined scientific, mathematical and practical requirements.
research_phases.decision: RESEARCH_REBOOT_NOT_JUSTIFIED; primary and backup NONE; held-outs CLOSED.

research_phases.motivation: Turn the existing model into a stable software baseline.
research_phases.approach: Performance parity, API lifecycle, examples, persistence, compatibility and release engineering.
research_phases.evaluation: Bounded engineering and contract validation; separate from algorithm comparisons.
research_phases.result: Stable contracts and measured implementation improvements without a new algorithmic promotion.

experiment_families.problem: Ordinary mixed-data learning with bounded training.
experiment_families.result: Retained as the stable backbone; width, depth and longer-training alternatives did not establish a general replacement.

experiment_families.problem: Imputation, missing states, embeddings, frequency, robust/rank transforms and cross-fitted target encoding.
experiment_families.result: Stable train-only representations remain; alternative transforms had local or inconclusive benefits. Target encoding was tested, without a general promotion.

experiment_families.problem: Improve optimization and input selection without excessive capacity.
experiment_families.result: Earlier GELU gains did not survive general-default confirmation. H12 input gating was historically positive but remained unpromoted; it differs from the public opt-in gate.
experiment_families.phases: H2, H5, H6, H6C, CORE_GELU, H12

experiment_families.problem: Represent heterogeneous feature interactions.
experiment_families.result: Positive average attention results coexisted with a worst-case regression in classification performance; the attention-specific explanation was not isolated. Mixer variants lacked general support.

experiment_families.problem: Capture sparse or higher-order interactions compactly.
experiment_families.result: Synthetic or local gains did not establish robust real-data transfer; no general interaction replacement was promoted.

experiment_families.problem: Adapt representation or allocate specialists to rows.
experiment_families.result: Routing gains reversed on evaluation or incurred excess cost. Mixtures and ensembles did not establish a robust, practical general benefit.

experiment_families.problem: Learn structured decision boundaries within neural training.
experiment_families.result: Bounded differentiable-tree screens did not support promotion; this does not reject all tree methods.

experiment_families.problem: Use local residual information.
experiment_families.result: Some regression gains were retained as signals; inference cost, retained state and insufficient breadth prevented promotion.

experiment_families.problem: Change update frequency, loss, batch size, regularization or stopping.
experiment_families.result: Most screens were inconclusive or specialized. Later controls exposed learning-rate, exposure and stopping confounds; no general replacement emerged.
experiment_families.phases: Micro-Lab, H3, H5, H7, H15, H23

experiment_families.problem: Improve ranking, probability quality or trajectory stability.
experiment_families.result: Averaging improved mean AUC but failed variance and concentration gates. Calibration safeguards stabilized narrow cases without general real-data ranking benefit.

experiment_families.problem: Select a representation or training policy from training evidence.
experiment_families.result: Selection overhead and weak broad gains prevented promotion. The policy oracle did not justify training a meta-policy; an oracle is not an implemented learner.

experiment_families.problem: Improve a fixed backbone through auxiliary training.
experiment_families.result: Bounded screens produced no general survivor. Regression compute gains were insufficiently practical under the frozen cost gate.

experiment_families.problem: Fit residual information in an additional stage.
experiment_families.result: Gains against the cheaper baseline did not survive comparison with the stronger compute control.

experiment_families.problem: Share training across multiple input/output streams.
experiment_families.result: A positive mean was concentrated in few datasets, with a negative median and severe failures. Subsequent diagnostics did not justify safe routing.

experiment_families.problem: Test bounded alternatives to ordinary neural representations.
experiment_families.result: The original symmetric circuit implementation was invalid; the corrected circuit and relaxed-logic prototypes lacked a general signal.

experiment_families.problem: Use an implicit learned representation.
experiment_families.result: An initial binary signal failed fresh specialist confirmation. Only the bounded tested recipes are covered.

experiment_families.problem: Learn a reusable predictor from synthetic tasks.
experiment_families.result: A small prototype lacked practical broad evidence. The later shared amortized pilot failed frozen synthetic gates before any real-data evaluation. Large pretrained systems were not evaluated by these tests.

experiment_families.problem: Transfer a tree teacher through out-of-fold training targets.
experiment_families.result: Positive mean but negative median and inclusive teacher cost prevented promotion; additional conditional arms were not triggered.

experiment_families.problem: Transfer structural information instead of teacher predictions.
experiment_families.result: An early descriptive hint failed the threshold control; prospective graph transfer did not confirm the mechanism.

experiment_families.problem: Use task-specific grouping, class representations or regression objectives.
experiment_families.result: Eight bounded forms produced no survivor. Some panels stopped early after severe failures; a robust-regression gain depended on one dataset.

experiment_families.problem: Improve uncertainty without changing the point predictor.
experiment_families.result: Some Gaussian likelihood gains occurred, but coverage and breadth gates failed. The mean prediction remained unchanged; no interval API resulted.

experiment_families.problem: Recover complementary errors through an out-of-fold blend.
experiment_families.result: The blend improved over the neural baseline, but did not robustly improve over the tree comparator and had high inclusive cost and unstable weights.

experiment_families.problem: Allocate model capacity during learning.
experiment_families.result: Mechanical defects were repaired before scientific testing; the repaired recipe then failed quality and robustness gates.

experiment_families.problem: Profile a supervised readout during representation learning.
experiment_families.result: Mechanical and numerical acceptance contracts failed before scientific fits. Quality remains unevaluated; the exact line is operationally closed.

experiment_families.problem: Seek a justified next mechanism after earlier failures.
experiment_families.result: Overlap, incomplete specification, unsupported causal premises or practical scope prevented admission. Unexecuted proposals are not empirical negative results.

experiment_families.problem: Understand failure categories and improve implementation cost.
experiment_families.result: Diagnostics found multiple partial mechanisms, without a universal cause. Performance engineering improved measured workloads while preserving model behavior.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Capture sparse or higher-order interactions compactly.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Synthetic or local gains did not establish robust real-data transfer; no general interaction replacement was promoted.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Adapt representation or allocate specialists to rows.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Routing gains reversed on evaluation or incurred excess cost. Mixtures and ensembles did not establish a robust, practical general benefit.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Learn structured decision boundaries within neural training.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Bounded differentiable-tree screens did not support promotion; this does not reject all tree methods.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Use local residual information.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Some regression gains were retained as signals; inference cost, retained state and insufficient breadth prevented promotion.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Change update frequency, loss, batch size, regularization or stopping.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Most screens were inconclusive or specialized. Later controls exposed learning-rate, exposure and stopping confounds; no general replacement emerged.
non_promoted_mechanisms.phases: Micro-Lab, H3, H5, H7, H15, H23

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Improve ranking, probability quality or trajectory stability.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Averaging improved mean AUC but failed variance and concentration gates. Calibration safeguards stabilized narrow cases without general real-data ranking benefit.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Select a representation or training policy from training evidence.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Selection overhead and weak broad gains prevented promotion. The policy oracle did not justify training a meta-policy; an oracle is not an implemented learner.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Improve a fixed backbone through auxiliary training.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Bounded screens produced no general survivor. Regression compute gains were insufficiently practical under the frozen cost gate.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Fit residual information in an additional stage.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Gains against the cheaper baseline did not survive comparison with the stronger compute control.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Share training across multiple input/output streams.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: A positive mean was concentrated in few datasets, with a negative median and severe failures. Subsequent diagnostics did not justify safe routing.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Test bounded alternatives to ordinary neural representations.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: The original symmetric circuit implementation was invalid; the corrected circuit and relaxed-logic prototypes lacked a general signal.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Use an implicit learned representation.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: An initial binary signal failed fresh specialist confirmation. Only the bounded tested recipes are covered.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Learn a reusable predictor from synthetic tasks.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: A small prototype lacked practical broad evidence. The later shared amortized pilot failed frozen synthetic gates before any real-data evaluation. Large pretrained systems were not evaluated by these tests.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Transfer a tree teacher through out-of-fold training targets.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Positive mean but negative median and inclusive teacher cost prevented promotion; additional conditional arms were not triggered.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Transfer structural information instead of teacher predictions.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: An early descriptive hint failed the threshold control; prospective graph transfer did not confirm the mechanism.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Use task-specific grouping, class representations or regression objectives.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Eight bounded forms produced no survivor. Some panels stopped early after severe failures; a robust-regression gain depended on one dataset.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Improve uncertainty without changing the point predictor.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Some Gaussian likelihood gains occurred, but coverage and breadth gates failed. The mean prediction remained unchanged; no interval API resulted.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Recover complementary errors through an out-of-fold blend.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: The blend improved over the neural baseline, but did not robustly improve over the tree comparator and had high inclusive cost and unstable weights.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Allocate model capacity during learning.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Mechanical defects were repaired before scientific testing; the repaired recipe then failed quality and robustness gates.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Profile a supervised readout during representation learning.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Mechanical and numerical acceptance contracts failed before scientific fits. Quality remains unevaluated; the exact line is operationally closed.

non_promoted_mechanisms.problem: Seek a justified next mechanism after earlier failures.
non_promoted_mechanisms.result: Overlap, incomplete specification, unsupported causal premises or practical scope prevented admission. Unexecuted proposals are not empirical negative results.

failure_modes.evidence: Perturbation and association evidence identified partial sensitivity, with confounding and counterexamples.
failure_modes.boundary: No general nuisance-removal cure was demonstrated.

failure_modes.evidence: Weak support, cardinality and conditional structure can coincide with failures; broad correlations changed after removing influential datasets.
failure_modes.boundary: Rare categories can also carry information; blanket suppression is not justified.

failure_modes.evidence: Interaction probes and tree comparisons exposed local representational gaps.
failure_modes.boundary: No controlled, practical mechanism solved them generally.

failure_modes.evidence: Some small datasets were difficult, but reduced-data controls contradicted a universal sample-size explanation.
failure_modes.boundary: Initialization, splits, support and finite capacity cannot be collapsed into one cause.

failure_modes.evidence: Tail-related comparisons supported some contrasts but included clear counterexamples.
failure_modes.boundary: Neither a universal tail diagnosis nor a robust-regression default was established.

benchmark_history.design: Small public/development and historical internal panels; partial original manifests.
benchmark_history.metrics_and_comparators: Binary ranking, probability quality and cost.
benchmark_history.limitations: Exploratory; older held-out sets differ from current reservations.

benchmark_history.design: Six batches, 54 IDs, 648 recorded fits; tiny real and synthetic panels.
benchmark_history.metrics_and_comparators: AUC, probability losses, training/exposure and inference cost.
benchmark_history.limitations: Baseline reuse, exploratory tiers and one-thread CPU scope; not independent 648-fold confirmation.
Engineering evidence; no broad accuracy ranking.

benchmark_history.design: 22 datasets, three seeds, five fixed recipes: 330 fits; 5 binary, 9 multiclass, 8 regression.
benchmark_history.metrics_and_comparators: Neural model and 100-iteration HGB, LightGBM, XGBoost and CatBoost recipes; no HPO.
benchmark_history.limitations: Development panel; nonisolated timing and recipe-specific comparisons.

benchmark_history.design: Paired real panels growing from 13 to 22 datasets.
benchmark_history.metrics_and_comparators: AUC plus log loss/Brier safety; phase-specific fixed seeds and controls.
benchmark_history.limitations: H6/H6C reuse and incomplete original CORE_GELU integrity limit interpretation.

benchmark_history.design: Staged multitask panels, including a 39-dataset development suite and narrower task panels.
benchmark_history.metrics_and_comparators: Capacity/compute controls, task-native metrics and phase-specific normalized gains.
benchmark_history.limitations: Early stops are not complete family rankings; teacher, selector and pretraining cost must be included.

benchmark_history.design: 23 diagnostic cohorts; blend 18 datasets by two seeds; growth 15 by two seeds.
benchmark_history.metrics_and_comparators: Failure associations, paired blend/growth quality and inclusive costs.
benchmark_history.limitations: Retrospective reuse, confounded interventions, unstable blend weights and incomplete compute eligibility.

benchmark_history.design: Official fixed TabM, RealMLP-TD-S, TabR and FT-Transformer recipes; staged panels.
benchmark_history.metrics_and_comparators: Native quality, matched neural controls and inclusive fit/inference cost.
benchmark_history.limitations: Incomplete matched coverage, censored attempts, timeouts and incompatibilities; no HPO or universal ranking.

benchmark_history.design: 27 UCI datasets by three seeds; grouped duplicate-feature 60/20/20 splits, four CPU threads.
benchmark_history.metrics_and_comparators: Fixed public 0.3.1 neural model versus HGB with 100 iterations, learning rate 0.1 and 31 leaves.
benchmark_history.limitations: Fresh relative to audited catalog; observational findings do not prove a universal failure cause.

research_guardrails.rule: The latest decision governs; infrastructure and old plans do not authorize experiments.
Six reserved datasets remain CLOSED; unresolved reservation identities/seeds prevent opening.
Resolve namespaces, aliases and lineage; new seeds are not new datasets and catalog absence is not proof of never-used status.
Keep preprocessing and selection training-only; pair splits and RNG roles and group duplicate features where required.
Freeze hypotheses, panel, metrics, controls, seeds, budgets, attempts and stop rules before outcomes; mechanical gates come first.
Use strong compute and capacity controls; distinguish correlation, oracle headroom and causal evidence.
Average seeds within datasets; report mean, median, breadth, worst case, seed consistency and contributor concentration.
Keep native metric meanings and phase-specific normalized-gain definitions separate.
Count selection, teachers, pretraining, solvers, refits, retrieval state, failed/censored attempts and cold/hot inference; missing cost is unknown.
Preserve source-bound attempts; separate replay, retiming, replication, invalid, censored and unexecuted work. Parity cannot repair missing original evidence.
Require a materially new premise, overlap and prior-art review, specification, controls, bounded cost and cheap falsification before admission.
Research is separate from stable defaults; maintenance is not an algorithmic quality claim.

known_limitations: Historical comparisons are workload-, recipe-, version- and budget-specific; they do not establish universal state-of-the-art performance.
Tree baselines often outperform the neural baseline on important development tasks; no single mechanism explains all losses.
Some positive means depend on a few datasets; worst-case, variance, cost and integrity gates can prevent promotion.

Some original manifests, auxiliary RNG roles and all-in compute totals are incomplete; the original Micro-Lab container and CORE_GELU confirmation cannot be fully authenticated from available records.
Dataset first-use and reserved held-out identity/seed records are incomplete; unknown identities are ineligible for reserved evaluation.
External neural comparisons include missing or ineligible cells, timeouts and incompatibilities, so coverage and censoring must accompany comparisons.
Synthetic learning, mechanical repair, algebraic checks and oracle analyses do not establish real-data generalization.
Supported persistence is bounded by tested same-build and pinned-runtime contracts; universal cross-version portability is not promised.
open_questions: How can statistical support constrain useful capacity without discarding rare informative features?
Can sparse or conditional interactions be learned robustly under dependence and limited data at practical training and inference cost?
How should irrelevant-feature sensitivity, rare-category behavior and target-tail failures be separated through controlled evidence?
Support-adaptive sparse interactions remain an unresolved conceptual direction, without an admitted algorithm or demonstrated benefit.
reopening_requirements: A zero-fit reopening audit establishes a materially new, source-supported premise.
An overlap check distinguishes the proposal from tested families and existing methods.
A prior-art and literature review clarifies established methods and unresolved questions.
An explicit mathematical and implementation specification defines targets, controls, support assumptions, cost and product compatibility.
A cheap falsification plan freezes mechanical checks, failure predictions, comparison rules, budgets and stop conditions.
An explicit admission decision must precede any possible scientific fits; held-outs remain CLOSED and require a separate opening decision.

public_evidence_scope.basis: Reviewed historical research reports, source-pinned configurations, result summaries and stable software contracts.
public_evidence_scope.availability: Curated synthesis; raw internal evidence is retained separately and is not installed with the package.
public_evidence_scope.time_scope: Historical evidence through R38 and the stable 1.0.2 baseline; no new scientific execution in preparing this snapshot.
public_evidence_scope.claim_scope: Results describe the recorded workloads and exact tested forms. Unexecuted proposals and mechanically blocked methods have no empirical quality verdict.
public_evidence_scope.family_boundary: H19 PC means probabilistic circuits. A completed predictive-coding evaluation is not established by the reviewed history.

external_neural_benchmark.cost_scope: Stage B completed development calls on differing coverage, including the separate simulator supplement; primary quality uses observational datasets. Batch latency is not single-row service throughput. Compute controls are phase-specific CPU work, not parameter or exact-FLOP matching.
external_neural_benchmark.interpretation: All three Stage B survivors improved on the cheaper N0 in mean; stronger controls, robustness gates and incomplete matched coverage prevented general promotion. These normalized gains are not raw AUC differences.
